articles.description: US President Donald Trump may be shifting his focus from a new nuclear agreement with Iran to reopening the Strait of Hormuz. According to reports, Washington could maintain the current ceasefire and potentially suspend efforts for a new nuclear deal if Iran fully restores shipping through the strategic waterway. Tehran is reportedly demanding sanctions relief, an end to the U.S. naval blockade, the withdrawal of American forces and financial compensation in return. With Hormuz crucial to global energy supplies, the standoff could have major consequences for oil prices, regional security and the future of U.S.-Iran relations.

articles.title: Cockroach protests: parents of Indian students who took their own lives reveal pressure of leaked exam papers and resits
articles.description: The number of student suicides in the country has risen steeply in the past 10 years and many families blame education system mismanagement as a contributing factor When the Indian government announced the resignation of its education minister in late July after weeks of protest, there were widespread celebrations. Students from across the country had joined the mass demonstrations led by the Cockroach Janta party amid growing resentment over repeated examination cancellations and question paper leaks. The pressure of exams in the country has only increased in recent years. The number of student suicides rose from 8,068 in 2014, to 14,488 in 2024 – an increase of roughly 80% – according to the Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India report released by the country’s National Crime Records Bureau. After family problems, failure in examinations has been listed as the leading cause of suicides among students. Continue reading...
